# Antoine Vernet

> Antoine Vernet is an Associate Professor in Management at the Bartlett School of Sustainable Construction, University College London (UCL). He studies the interplay between formal and informal structures of organizations — social networks, organizational design, strategy, and organizational behaviour — and how these affect individual and organizational outcomes. He holds a PhD in Sociology from Université Paris Nanterre (2010) and was previously a research associate at Imperial College Business School. ORCID: 0000-0002-7546-9829.

Current work includes the impact of hybrid working on collaboration and knowledge sharing, the role of network structures in innovation, organizational change, mapping organizational knowledge, and over-optimism and cognitive biases in project estimation. He leads the UCL Grand Challenges project "From Hybrid Work to Hybrid Workforces: Rethinking Organisational Design for an AI-Augmented Future". He teaches organizational design, data analytics, and social network analysis.
